The Blue Book: direct search and iProView pages blocked (403); found New South Specialties only through a search summary

candidates.name: Martin+Murray Installation, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Services page lists Toilet Partitions and Toilet Accessories under Division 10, alongside lockers, wall protection and other specialties.
red_flags: Contact email is a named person's address, not a generic one
No product brands or restroom project photos seen; site describes itself as installation-only, so no supply evidence either way
candidates.reason: Charleston-based commercial installer of doors, hardware and Division 10 specialties that lists toilet partitions as a service; serves medical, education, hospitality and public-sector clients across the Southeast.
